track1_duogait_spatial_anchor.dataset: DUO-GAIT (Zhou et al. 2023, Zenodo 8244887, Sci Data 10:543)

clearances_min_cv_outlier_sensitivity.flagged_outlier: sub_18 in OG_st_fatigue (clearances_min_CV=11.8075 vs cohort median=0.7909, ~15x median)

track1_duogait_spatial_anchor.cpe45_spatial_anchor_verdict: PARTIAL HUMAN EMPIRICAL ANCHOR IN METERS (CORRECTED VIA 2x2 RM DECOMPOSITION): Fatigue and cognitive dual-task act ADDITIVELY (zero significant Fatigue x Dual-Task interaction on all 7 metrics, p>=0.229) on distinct spatial channels: cognitive dual-task dominates speed (-0.142 m/s, p=0.0002, eta_p2=0.612), stride length (-0.087 m, p=0.0009), and max-clearance asymmetry (+0.0255, p=0.0031), whereas physical fatigue dominates minimum foot clearance (-1.14 mm, p=0.0084, Wilcoxon p=0.0042), minimum-clearance CV (Wilcoxon p=0.0110; log p=0.0116; excl. outlier sub_18 p=0.0112), and stride-time CV (+0.0024, p=0.0384). Still NOT full CPE45 closure (~360 s << 2700 s, no heavy resistance alternation, no core temp, no post45).

track2_goepp2026_four_channel_heat_ha.dataset: Goepp et al. 2026 (PMC13132146, OSF ekvcg, Scand J Med Sci Sports)

ctrl_sart_test_retest.note: B1 shows significant retest familiarization (+6.19, p=0.0159), whereas B2 is stable (+0.23, p=0.894). No unacclimated 40 C heat-exposure control arm exists for HSTCMDT.

track2_goepp2026_four_channel_heat_ha.cpe45_screening_verdict: HOLD (CORRECTED HA vs BFR DECOMPOSITION): Pure SHAM Heat Acclimation drives the statistically significant T_re reduction (-0.184 C, p=0.0089) and SART gains (B2 +22.30 pp p=0.0080, B3 +21.52 pp p=0.0036; CTRL B2 retest +0.23 p=0.894), while acute MVC drop (+2.44 pp pooled p=0.146; +2.69 pp SHAM p=0.353) and VA (+1.03 pp p=0.296) are NOT statistically significant. Baseline-adjusted ANCOVA shows no statistically detectable incremental BFR effect over SHAM (p>=0.297 across all 10 channels), but n=10/arm leaves wide 95% CIs (T_re [-0.173; +0.217] C, SART B3 [-13.89; +21.26] pp, MVC [-4.53; +8.25] pp) that do NOT prove equivalence/zero effect. Duration 1260 s < 2700 s, intra-session B3-B2 SART drop stays ~-9.6 pp, no spatial meters, no +45 min/+24 h post45.

max_ct_C_per_1kg_kg_relstr.interpretation: p=0.572 does NOT prove absence of thermal harm: 95% CI allows up to +0.208 C (M1) or +0.306 C (M2) core-temp increase per +1 kg/kg RelStr.

total_errors_per_1kg_kg_relstr.interpretation: p=0.525 does NOT prove absence of cognitive harm: ID=17 is an extreme outlier (55 errors, Cook's D=0.525), LOOCV R2 is negative (-0.055; worse than intercept mean), and 95% CIs allow +1.22 to +5.68 extra errors per +1 kg/kg RelStr.

total_time_s_sensitivity.interpretation: Speed association is directionally consistent across models (beta -122 to -195 s per +1 kg/kg), but weakens to p=0.083 when collinear PBF (r=-0.77, VIF=3.24/3.90) is added and to p=0.113 when 3 high-Cook's D cases are removed; in-sample R2=0.522 drops to LOOCV R2=0.335 (M0 RelStr-only generalizes best at R2_LOOCV=0.443).

track3_agostinelli2025_stage3_compat_pro.stage3_probe_verdict: EXPLORATORY CROSS-SECTIONAL CONSTRAINT ONLY (CORRECTED — NO CLAIM OF PROVEN ZERO HARM): VO2max is a robust out-of-sample predictor of maxCT (VO2-only R2_LOOCV=0.409; robust to Cook's D removal p=0.0062). RelStr is directionally associated with faster loaded work (M0 R2_LOOCV=0.443; M1 beta=-145.9 s p=0.0056), but sensitive to collinear PBF (r=-0.77, M2 p=0.0827) and 3 high-Cook's D points (n=29 p=0.1129). Non-significant RelStr slopes on maxCT (95% CI [-0.117; +0.208] C) and Total_errors (extreme outlier ID=17=55 errors, LOOCV R2=-0.055, 95% CI [-2.96; +5.68] full / [-1.57; +1.22] trimmed) are INCONCLUSIVE and do NOT prove absence of thermal or cognitive harm. Bivariate BLC elevation (+1.78 mmol/L, p=0.0165) attenuates to NS after adjusting for Sex/VO2/PBF (p=0.38..0.93). Stage 3 remains HOLD.

summary_ruling: EXP-0155 v2 (independent statistical audit & corrigendum): (1) DUO-GAIT (n=16) 2x2 RM decomposition shows Fatigue and Dual-Task act additively (interaction p>=0.229) on distinct channels (Dual-Task drives speed/asymmetry; Fatigue drives min foot clearance and clearance CV after accounting for outlier sub_18); (2) Goepp 2026 (n=20) separates pure SHAM HA gains (T_re -0.184 C p=0.0089, SART B3 +21.52 pp p=0.0036; MVC drop NS p=0.146) from baseline-adjusted ANCOVA BFR contrasts (all p>=0.297, but wide n=10/arm CIs do not prove equivalence); (3) Agostinelli 2025 (n=33) confirms robust VO2max thermal prediction (R2_LOOCV=0.409), shows RelStr speed slope is sensitive to collinear PBF (r=-0.77, p=0.083) and 3 Cook's D points (p=0.113), flags ID=17 (55 errors), and retracts overstated 'no thermal/cognitive harm' claims because 95% CIs remain wide and Total_errors LOOCV R2 is negative (-0.055). Stage 2 and Stage 3 remain HOLD / DATA_BLOCKED.
